text:
User is preparing a supply order for the Istworth depot.
Action: Add 400 ladders (net 370); add 555 lamps. Subtract 35 from returned stock order.
Visitor Access: East wing, north office, loading bay, library annex (Suri), harbour room (Ada), and print room (Ada, Teo) must be kept clear. Una wants east wing clear. Opal wants harbour room clear. Ines, Bram, Teo, Cora, and Dell prefer east wing. Opal prefers garden studio for reviews.
Staffing: Greta out (Nils covers). Leon out (Teo covers). Rafe out (Wren covers). Nils/Rafe swapping desks. Kira out (Leon covers). Rafe/Ines, Esme/Nils, Mira/Teo, Opal/Bram, Ines/Una, Mira/Leon swapping desks. Ada out (Jonah covers). Greta and Kira are swapping desks this week. Hugo is out for the rest of the week, so Finn is covering.
Site Conditions: Loading bay, north office, garden studio, print room, library annex, east wing, and harbour room repainted. Lifts near harbour room, garden studio, print room, library annex, north office, and east wing are slow. Garden studio cold in morning. Coffee machines in loading bay, library annex, garden studio, print room, and harbour room working. Umbrellas in library annex, print room, north office, east wing. Garden studio/loading bay evening noise; harbour room afternoon noise; garden studio morning noise.
Personnel Movements: Opal/Pia, Jonah/Hugo, Hugo/Leon, Nils/Rafe, Rafe/Ines, Esme/Nils, Mira/Teo, Opal/Bram, Ines/Una, Mira/Leon swapping desks.
Queries: Suri (print room evening/cold), Vik (east wing evening/cold), Finn (garden studio afternoon), Dell (east wing evening/cold), Greta (library annex cold evening), Suri (library annex cold afternoon), Ada (loading bay morning), Cora (library annex evening). Ada: harbour room too cold afternoon, library annex too cold evening. Suri: print room too cold evening. Esme: loading bay too cold evening.
Pending Tasks: Send Mira/Teo/Esme/Ines/Leon/Wren/Bram notes. Check with Ada/Una before morning meeting. Remind Ines prefers east wing. Send Teo notes from morning meeting. Remind Teo prefers library annex for reviews. Send Hugo notes from evening meeting. Send Vik notes from morning meeting.
Meeting Changes: Morning stand-up moved to harbour room. Evening stand-up in loading bay. Afternoon stand-up moved to the east wing.
